reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: I was optimistic to start with but the fact that you can’t add NFL teams to your feed or remove WSL is a major letdown for me. I’d have thought what with Sky being one of the richest organisations on the planet that they might be able to make a fully customisable app but apparently not. Most other apps do allow full customisation of your feed so why didn’t Sky? Instead they’re too busy forcing us to care about things not everyone cares about.

reviews.title: Audio keeps switching between quiet and loud
reviews.text:
The app works well overall, but there is a really frustrating audio issue when watching live sport on iPhone or iPad. The volume keeps changing by itself, with the sound suddenly becoming quieter and then louder again, almost as if it is switching between mono and stereo audio.

It happens repeatedly during live streams and makes commentary and crowd noise inconsistent and distracting. I’ve tried force closing the app and checking my iPhone’s audio settings, but the issue persists.

Please investigate, as it significantly affects the viewing experience.

reviews.title: Once a good app

When you have many videos to watch some of which are less than a minute anyway, it is extremely annoying to have to watch a minimum of 30secs of ads with every video. At least remember that you have showed me the same ad over and over. 
And stop asking me every time I open the app to accept cookies. Extremely annoying especially as this app use to be brilliant.

reviews.title: Constantly has something wrong with it. Better offers at betting competitors as well. Not good.
reviews.text: The super 6 has a glitch on my iPhone this week, where I put my details in to sign in, it constantly glitches so you can’t put your results in or access the prediction area. The sky bet addition to the app is very poor as well. You get free bets every week and decent price boosts at Ladbrokes but sky bet are well behind and don’t give a competitive price either. It’s just a poor app by a company desperately scraping for money as people realise that streaming the premier league and dodgy boxes are the future of sports. Sky  are an awful company.
